direction-type.words: The suspension does not neutralize parallel fifths and octaves.
With descending suspensions, the resolution tone should not be occupied.
An exception to the previous rule: the tone of resolution can be occupied in the
bass at a ninth distance, and this tone must be the root of a triad or seventh chord.
For incomplete triads, this exception is possible for the tenor.
other voices may have passing tones.
At the moment of suspension resolution, another voice may descend on the passing seventh.
